in_hebrew.name: Arda
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mountain, high place

In the Bible, Arda is a place name mentioned in Jeremiah 51:25. This name evokes a sense of strength, stability, and spiritual connection to the natural world.
